title: Discount Stacking Across a Mid-Year Rule Change
scenario_text:
A deal desk analyst at Elmswood Media must decide whether two discounts may be stacked on a renewal, given two prior decisions that straddle a rule change.

**Decision A (2024-02)**
Customer 'Ravenscar Press' | 2-year renewal | total contract value (TCV) $520K. Requested to stack the 12% loyalty discount with the 8% multi-year discount. Deal Desk DENIED. Note: 'Stacking then required TCV of at least $1M; Ravenscar was $520K. Only one discount could apply.'

**Decision B (2024-06)**
Customer 'Saltby Media' | 3-year renewal | TCV $640K. Requested the same stacking. Deal Desk APPROVED. Note: 'Under the new stacking rule effective 2024-05-01, renewals with a term of 3 years or longer qualify for stacking regardless of TCV.'

**Current request C (2024-11-12)**
Customer 'Tewkes Media' | 3-year renewal | TCV $580K. Requesting to stack the 12% loyalty discount with the 8% multi-year discount.

**Discount Stacking Policy (current, effective 2024-05-01)**
The 12% loyalty discount may stack with the 8% multi-year discount when EITHER the TCV is at least $1M OR the renewal term is 3 years or longer. Term-based qualification has been available since May 1, 2024.

**Slack — #deal-desk**
AE: 'We denied stacking for Ravenscar last February at around this TCV, so Tewkes should be denied too, right?'
Analyst: 'Ravenscar was denied under the old TCV-only rule. Saltby got stacking approved in June under the new term-based rule. Let me line Tewkes up against the current policy.'

Tewkes is a 3-year renewal below $1M TCV, just like Saltby was.
question: How should the analyst handle Tewkes Media's discount-stacking request?
choices: Deny stacking, consistent with the February denial of a similar-TCV stacking request for Ravenscar.
Approve stacking, because under the current rule a 3-year renewal qualifies regardless of TCV — so the June Saltby approval, not the pre-May Ravenscar denial, is the governing precedent.
Escalate to VP Sales, since stacking two discounts below $1M TCV exceeds Deal Desk authority.
Apply only the 12% loyalty discount as a compromise between the February denial and the June approval.
